jcr:content.jcr:title: Svalbard Trekking

hero-mount.headline: Svalbard
hero-mount.subheadline: Ten days crossing the world's northernmost wilderness — ice caps, polar bears, and the Arctic Ocean at 78° North.

text_intro.text:
Into the high Arctic

Svalbard sits halfway between mainland Norway and the North Pole — a frozen archipelago of glaciers, fjords, and 24-hour summer light. Our small-group trek follows ancient trapper routes, camping on moraines and crossing blue-ice glacier tongues with a certified polar guide.

image_primary.alt: Trekkers on a glacier at dawn under polar light

text_body.text:
Route highlights

  • Longyearbyen base camp & gear check with our Arctic team.
  • Crossing the Von Postbreen glacier with crampons and roped travel.
  • Wild camps on the shores of Tempelfjorden — eiders, seals, and the occasional reindeer.
  • Armed guide at all times; strict polar-bear safety protocol.

Fitness & preparation

You should be comfortable hiking 15–20 km per day with a 15 kg pack over uneven, sometimes icy terrain. No prior glacier experience needed — we run a full technical briefing on Day 1.
